sections.heading: 1. How Sound is Produced
points: **Sound is produced by vibrating objects** (a to-and-fro motion).
In humans, sound is produced by the **voice box (larynx)** with its **vocal cords**.
**Sound needs a medium** (solid, liquid or gas) to travel — it **cannot travel through vacuum** (that's why there's no sound in space).

sections.heading: 2. Properties of Sound Waves
points: **Frequency** = number of vibrations (oscillations) per second; unit = **hertz (Hz)**.
**Amplitude** = the size of the vibration (how far it moves).
**Time period** = time for one oscillation.
Sound travels slower than light; it needs a medium and travels fastest in **solids**, slower in gases.

sections.heading: 3. Pitch and Loudness
points: **Pitch (shrillness)** depends on **frequency** — higher frequency = higher pitch (e.g. a whistle); lower frequency = low pitch (e.g. a drum).
**Loudness** depends on **amplitude** — larger amplitude = louder sound.
Loudness is measured in **decibels (dB)**.

sections.heading: 4. Audible Range and Noise
points: **Audible range** for humans = **20 Hz to 20,000 Hz**.
Below 20 Hz = **infrasonic**; above 20,000 Hz = **ultrasonic** (heard by dogs, bats, dolphins).
**Noise** = unpleasant sound; **noise pollution** (above ~80 dB) harms health (hearing loss, stress, sleeplessness).
Reduce noise: plant trees, control traffic/loudspeakers, use silencers.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Sound is produced by vibration; needs a medium (no sound in vacuum).
Frequency (Hz) → pitch; amplitude → loudness (measured in decibels).
Human audible range = 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz.
Below 20 Hz = infrasonic; above 20,000 Hz = ultrasonic.
Sound is produced by the larynx (vocal cords); noise pollution harms health.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Sound cannot travel through vacuum** — it needs a medium.
**Pitch depends on frequency**; **loudness depends on amplitude** — don't swap.
Human audible range = **20–20,000 Hz**.
**Ultrasonic** = above 20,000 Hz (heard by bats/dogs); **infrasonic** = below 20 Hz.
